slides.h: For when you need [[fire in your veins]]: 5 shows that work like caffeine.

slides.title: Gurren Lagann
slides.why: Starts underground, ends past the galaxy. Pure escalation as a life philosophy.

slides.title: Haikyuu!!
slides.why: A volleyball show that makes every rally feel like a title fight.

slides.title: One Punch Man
slides.why: The strongest hero alive is bored, and the fights are still spectacular.

slides.title: Demon Slayer
slides.why: The production values alone can restart a dead week.

slides.title: Kill la Kill
slides.why: A scissor blade, a talking uniform, and no brakes anywhere in the building.
